args.command: echo '=== commands ==='; command -v chatgpt || true; command -v openai || true; command -v codex || true; echo '=== desktop entries ==='; find /usr/share/applications /usr/local/share/applications -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -iname '*chatgpt*' -o -iname '*openai*' \) -print 2>/dev/null || true; echo '=== opt/usr local matches ==='; find /opt /usr/local/bin /usr/bin -maxdepth 3 \( -type f -o -type l \) \( -iname '*chatgpt*' -o -iname '*openai*' \) -print 2>/dev/null | head -n 120 || true; echo '=== packages ==='; dpkg -l 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'chatgpt|openai' || true; snap list 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'chatgpt|openai' || true; flatpak list 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'chatgpt|openai' || true; echo '=== processes ==='; ps -eo pid,user,args | grep -Ei '[c]hatgpt|[o]penai' || true; echo '=== user services ==='; systemctl --user list-units --all 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'chatgpt|openai' || true; echo 'MA2_WRITES=0'; echo 'MA3_WRITES=0'

meta.summary: Inspect installed ChatGPT Linux app/runtime on Mini and distinguish it from CX CLI
